hook.name: PegomonHook
hook.description: A tax hook for a PEGOMON token pool that extracts a 3% tax on every swap (2.5% to a prize vault, 0.5% to a platform wallet) using beforeSwap delta returns. In afterSwap, qualifying ETH buys trigger tiered Pokeball awards via an external catcher contract, with bonus flags for whale buys, sell-streak resets, price dip timing, and daily buy count milestones.
